extraction.notes: Three months ended December 31, 2023 column only. Amounts in thousands. Core FFO and Core AFFO are MAA's named metrics; AFFO subtracts recurring capex so no separate capex disclosure needed. Zero-valued lines (printed as dashes) included with amount 0: gain on sale of non-depreciable real estate, debt extinguishment, COVID-19 costs, and mark-to-market debt adjustment. The mark-to-market debt adjustment is tagged debt_cost_amortization as the closest fit (it adjusts interest expense for debt premium/discount); Q4 value is zero so this does not affect totals. Per-share checks: 303,543/119,837=2.53; 277,762/119,837=2.32; 251,444/119,837=2.10. Subtotals tie. FAD ($199,309) is below AFFO and was not included, per the AFFO-level extraction.
